caption: The same uncut train station shot continues without a transition. The same adult woman continues turning to her right until she is seen in profile and then slightly from behind. Her copper bob with blunt bangs, olive skin, green eyes when visible, silver nose stud, navy wool coat, mustard yellow scarf with thin black stripes, black leather gloves, and square tan satchel stay unchanged. Smooth continuous motion, no jump cut, fluorescent station lighting, shallow depth of field.
